text.p: Car dealership firm AIR Holdings NV said it had issued 275,812 preference shares which had been placed with the Stichting Continuiteit AIR Holdings NV.
AIR Holdings set up Stichting Continuiteit AIR Holdings NV as a defensive vehicle in October after the Wilton family sold its 47 percent stake in the company.
It said at the time this was necessary because it no longer had a stable and dependable long-term major shareholder.
The preference shares placed with the stichting (foundation) have a price of 50 guilders each, of which 12.50 guilders per share has been paid up.
AIR Holdings said the preference shares would be withdrawn as soon as the threat which had led to their issue was over.
